structured_output.analysis: Base iso_3.15 has measured KL 0.43614 (E514ab09c524e) at 3.14795 avg bits. The budget is 403/128 = 3.1484 bits, so there is almost no spare room. The single-layer prediction (0.398) was below the measured value, which suggests layers interact. The rht_gptq_int2 layers lose the most and gain the most from one more bit. For layer 14.down_proj, rht_gptq_int2 measured 0.00633 (E4c3f9b73e065) and rht_gptq_int3 measured 0.00181 (E90bd4b2f3645). Direct upgrades need funding, so I'm trying two things. The first is option changes that cost no bits (act_order). The second is paying for int2 to int3 upgrades with group_size=256 on rht_gptq_int3, which stores fewer scales. Record E111111111111 (quip_e8p) is not a method in the option space, so I ignored it.

proposals.name: iso_actorder
proposals.rationale: This proposal only changes an option, so stored bits stay the same. It sets act_order=true for all GPTQ variants in base iso_3.15 (KL 0.43614, E514ab09c524e). The largest losses are in GPTQ-quantized MLP layers, for example 27.up_proj gptq_int3 at 0.0057182 (Ef04d8aa7bded) and 3.up_proj rht_gptq_int3 at 0.0064177 (E6f4f7ea296d5).

proposals.name: iso_g256_int2up
proposals.rationale: This moves three top-loss rht_gptq_int2 layers up to rht_gptq_int3. Setting group_size=256 on rht_gptq_int3 is meant to pay for them through lower scale overhead. Measured single-layer KL for 14.down_proj is 0.00633466 at rht_gptq_int2 (E4c3f9b73e065) and 0.00181478 at rht_gptq_int3 (E90bd4b2f3645). 18.gate_proj measures 0.00497 KL above floor (Eb1dd74cd6447) and 11.gate_proj measures 0.00443 (E9c454f30c659).

proposals.name: iso_g256_int2up_actorder
proposals.rationale: This combines the three int2 to int3 upgrades with act_order=true, to offset the accuracy cost of group_size=256. 14.down_proj measures 0.00633466 at rht_gptq_int2 (E4c3f9b73e065) and 0.00181478 at rht_gptq_int3 (E90bd4b2f3645). The base KL is 0.43614 (E514ab09c524e).
